The Dog That Found the Way Home: Max is a small brown dog. One day, he follows a rabbit out of the garden and gets lost.
Max walks for a long time. He is hungry and tired. At night, he sleeps under a big tree.

The next morning, Max smells something. It is bread from the bakery near his home! He follows the smell, crosses two streets, and finally sees his house. His family is waiting at the door. Everyone is happy to see him.
